title: 약속 시간 정하기: 몇 시에 만날까요?
objective: Say clock times (오전/오후, 시, 분, 반) and suggest another time with a reason using -(으)니까.
summary: Two classmates choose a study time, giving reasons with -(으)니까.
setting: Minsu and Anna plan to study together at the library tomorrow.

task.title: Plan a time with -(으)니까
task.line: Use the dialogue, the times, and -(으)니까 from page 1 to answer each question.

words.meaning: what time (시 = o'clock; count with 한, 두, 세, 네…)
minute (count with 일, 이, 삼…: 십 분, 오십 분)

words.exampleMeaning: I get up at eight thirty.
I work out in the morning.
I'm meeting a friend at 3 p.m.

words.meaning: to end, to finish (class, movie, work)
words.exampleMeaning: What time does the movie end?

words.meaning: because, so (gives a reason before a suggestion or request). After a final consonant: -으니까 (있으니까). After a vowel: -니까 (끝나니까).
words.exampleMeaning: We don't have time, so let's go quickly.

dialogue.korean: 같이 도서관에서 공부해요. 몇 시가 좋아요?
dialogue.meaning: Let's study together at the library. What time is good for you?
I have class in the morning, so let's meet in the afternoon.

dialogue.korean: 1시는 좀 빨라요. 수업이 12시 반에 끝나니까 2시에 만나요.
dialogue.meaning: 1 o'clock is a little early. My class ends at 12:30, so let's meet at 2.

dialogue.korean: 좋아요. 그럼 내일 오후 2시에 도서관에서 만나요.
dialogue.meaning: Okay. Then let's meet at the library at 2 p.m. tomorrow.

exercises: Choose the correct form: ① 표가 (없니까 / 없으니까) 다음 영화를 봐요. ② 비가 (오니까 / 오으니까) 우산을 가져가세요.
Read the dialogue and answer in Korean: ① 두 사람은 몇 시에 만나요? ② 안나 씨는 왜 오전에 못 만나요?
Write the time in Korean words: ① 9:30 a.m. ② 4:15 p.m.
Join the two sentences with -(으)니까: 내일은 수업이 없어요. + 같이 영화 봐요.
Complete B's reply with -(으)니까 and the word in brackets: A: 오늘 저녁 6시에 만날까요? B: 6시까지 ____ 7시에 만나요. (일하다)
answers: ① 오후 두 시에 만나요. (2시에 만나요.) ② 오전에 수업이 있어요. (수업이 있으니까요.)
① 오전 아홉 시 반 (오전 아홉 시 삼십 분) ② 오후 네 시 십오 분
내일은 수업이 없으니까 같이 영화 봐요.
